Rep. Jim Jordan warns that Democrats will weaponize congressional oversight and launch nonstop investigations if they win midterms.
Evidence: Congressional forecasts, committee hearings, partisan warnings
#Aletheia #USPol #Midterms

Jordan claims Democratic control of the House will result in unprecedented retaliatory investigations and impeachments.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, 0.0) — Good Preference

Both parties utilize congressional oversight instrumentally for partisan advantage and political defense when in power.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.88, -0.85) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Lawmakers project weaponization onto opponents to mobilize base voters while engaging in identical partisan oversight loops.

Integrity: Meaningful Distortion (Hypocrisy: 9.8, z: 4)

- Rep. Jim Jordan: FAIL (-0.90, -0.82) — Projects partisan intent onto rivals.
- Congressional Oversight: FAIL (-0.85, -0.88) — Instrumentalized for power.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confuses institutional accountability mechanisms (Q5) with partisan narrative warfare (Q4/Q7).

Social Physics Analysis:
Jim Jordan runs a Smart Selfish Maneuver, projecting future abuse onto opponents as a pretext to rally Republican donors and deflect from existing committee investigations.

The Unavoidable Lie: Only one political party engages in partisan investigations while the other champions neutral governance.
